text: dsh-web-search-provider 是一个 DSH 插件，让对话借助当前模型服务商提供的原生联网搜索。它接入 llm/stream，在符合条件的 agent 对话请求中改走 inline Responses 或 Anthropic Messages 流，并在服务端确认搜索能力后才启用。主要功能包括识别当前模型路由、探测搜索协议、注入原生搜索工具、将消息和工具调用转换为对应 API 格式，以及把流式结果和错误映射回 DSH。适合希望在模型当前回合内检索网络信息的 DSH 用户。需要可用的模型服务商 API 凭据和支持原生搜索的端点；默认跟随当前模型路由。

dsh-web-search-provider adds native web search to DSH conversations. It checks whether the current model route supports Responses or Anthropic Messages search, then sends eligible requests with a server-side search tool and returns results. Requires a provider credential and native search support.
想让 DSH 对话能直接联网查资料。
能不能让模型在回答当前问题时调用服务商自带的网页搜索？
我希望搜索结果能在同一轮对话里返回给模型。
让 DSH 根据当前模型路由自动选择支持搜索的 API。
I want my DSH conversations to search the web using my model provider's native capability.
Can DSH verify that a provider really runs web search before using it?
dsh-web-search-provider 的功能「同轮原生网页搜索」：符合门控条件的 agent 对话请求会在 llm/stream 中加入服务端 web_search 工具，使搜索随模型请求执行并将流式响应交回 DSH。
dsh-web-search-provider 的功能「搜索能力探测」：插件向候选 Responses 或 Messages 端点发送有时限的探测请求，并检查返回中是否包含搜索调用结果；探测失败的端点不会被选来服务。
dsh-web-search-provider 的功能「跟随当前模型路由」：插件读取 DSH 当前模型选择及其路由配置，解析协议、模型、基础地址和凭据引用，并在路由变化后重建搜索计划。
dsh-web-search-provider 的功能「协议消息转换」：插件把 DSH 消息、工具调用和结果序列化为 Responses 或 Anthropic Messages 格式，并将服务端搜索工具加入请求。
dsh-web-search-provider 的功能「来源与超时控制」：Responses 请求可包含搜索来源；inline 请求有空闲时限，探测也有独立时限，避免请求无限等待。
dsh-web-search-provider 使用当前模型路由或配置的服务商端点发送能力探测和对话请求；启用前需确认该服务商支持原生搜索并准备对应凭据。
配置 DSH 只在选定的模型服务商上启用在线检索。
I need DSH to use native search on a compatible Responses or Messages API route.

dsh-web-search-provider README · dsh-web-search-provider：[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-web-search-provider)

[简体中文](./README.zh.md)

Network search support for the Deepseek Harness, powered by the model provider's server-side capability.

Using this plugin requires the model provider to use the **OpenAI Responses API** or an **Anthropic-compatible Messages API**, and to **provide a web search capability**.

dsh-web-search-provider README · dsh-web-search-provider：> [!TIP]
> The Anthropic-compatible Messages API only provides a search capability, while the OpenAI Responses API additionally supports viewing a URL's page content / finding specific content within a URL's page. **Providers on the OpenAI Responses API are recommended.**

> [!TIP]
> Verified to work with: the Deepseek official Messages API (the DSH built-in Deepseek provider), the OpenCode Go Messages API, the OpenCode Go Response API, and an OpenAI relay station's Response API.

dsh-web-search-provider README · dsh-web-search-provider：> [!WARNING]
> The DSH built-in OpenCode Go provider uses different API types for different models. For example, for its Deepseek V4 Flash/Pro models, to use this plugin's capability you need to manually add a custom provider of the Response / Message API type.

> [!WARNING]
> Some model providers may charge extra for the web search capability this plugin uses.

dsh-web-search-provider README · dsh-web-search-provider：This plugin does not provide its support through the `web_search` tool inside the Deepseek Harness, so you can use it alongside other web search provider plugins (such as the built-in `web-search-deepseek`).

dsh-web-search-provider README · Comparing with web-search-deepseek：> TL;DR Compared with `web-search-deepseek`, this plugin has a clear advantage in both token consumption and time.

`web-search-deepseek` is the Deepseek Harness's built-in search plugin: when the model in a session calls the `web_search` tool, it creates a new internal session to run the search and returns several URLs with their content summaries.

dsh-web-search-provider README · Comparing with web-search-deepseek：Compared with `web-search-deepseek`, the AI in this plugin's sessions sends the network search request directly to the server, making **each individual search faster**. Also, the model can directly view / search page content (only with the **OpenAI Responses API**), reducing the tokens the AI spends on bash/curl to read a page's full content.

Using the Deepseek official Messages API's `deepseek-v4-flash model with high think`, each plugin performed 5 specified searches per run, tested 10 times:

dsh-web-search-provider README · Comparing with web-search-deepseek：| Plugin | Average tokens | Average time |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| web-search-deepseek | 4,446 | 47.5s |
| **web-search-provider** | **822** | **14.5s** |

Time is measured from the answer duration shown in the Deepseek Harness. Tokens are the average of the "output" tokens reported on the Deepseek Open Platform, using two different API tokens (because the Deepseek Harness does not count tokens consumed inside tool calls).

dsh-web-search-provider README · Comparing with web-search-deepseek：The results are for reference only. On tasks that need more web search content, this plugin is expected to show a more pronounced advantage.

dsh-web-search-provider README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-web-search-provider
```

dsh-web-search-provider README · Config：Settings section `web-search-provider` (a live namespace: edits reach the next request). All fields are optional unless noted.

dsh-web-search-provider README · Config：| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch; `false` sends every request down the normal adapter path. |
| `providers` | `[]` | Provider whitelist (llm-pi-ai route keys). A request is served only when its provider is also the current chat route (the plan derives its endpoint facts from that route); the whitelist restricts which of its providers may be served. Empty = serve the current chat route. |
| `baseURL` | route | Endpoint base override for the route's candidates; `/responses` or `/messages` is appended. |
| `model` | loop model | Model override; used by the capability probe and by the served wire request. |
| `apiKeyEnv` | route ref | Credential reference resolved per operation. |
| `includeSources` | `true` | Append `include: ['web_search_call.action.sources']` to Responses wire requests. |
| `stripServerTools` | `true` | Strip the function-tool variants (`web_search`/`open_page`/`find_in_page`) from the wire tools. |
| `idleTimeoutMs` | `300000` | Idle bound for one inline request, in milliseconds. |
| `probe` | `true` | Verify the endpoint executes native search before serving. |

dsh-web-search-provider README · Known limitations：- For providers that use the Response API / Message API **but do not provide a search capability**, the session **errors on first use**. Keep sending messages / open a new session and DSH keeps working without this plugin's capability.
- When the AI uses this plugin's web search capability, there is **no visible search-call UI**. The usage may appear as multiple consecutive thinking segments, with the tail of a thinking segment containing something like "*Let me make search queries*".

dsh-web-search-provider README · Building：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build        # tsc emits lib/types, tsdown bundles lib/index.js
pnpm test         # vitest unit suite
